spans.s:
n. (-ल्वः)
1 The womb.
2 The embryo.
3 The membranes investing the foetus.
4 A cavity.
E.
उच to accumulate, कन् Uṇādi affix, and च becomes ल.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Apparent, evident.
2 Much, exceeding.
n. (-णं)
An excess of either of the humors of the body, bile, phlegm or wind.
E.
उद् up, ल्वी to join, deriv. irr.
